_comment: Curated copy for Selected work. The workflow injects the volatile fields (stars, language, last push) from the API and drops any entry whose repo it cannot see. Written by hand on purpose: several of these repositories have no GitHub description, so generating this section from the API alone would replace good writing with blank cells. Keep each body to one or two sentences - a recruiter scans this in seconds.

projects.title: Stock Analysis
projects.body: Answers "why did Tesla drop today" by splitting the work across specialised agents — ticker resolution, prices, news, history, then synthesis. The half that makes it usable is the rate limiting and caching around two market APIs that fail in different ways.

projects.title: Eye Gaze Tracking
projects.body: Webcam to cursor control, end to end: dataset normalisation, training, then real-time inference. Several backbones sit behind one evaluation harness, because "which is better" is only answerable if you can swap them without rewriting the pipeline.

projects.title: Portfolio
projects.body: Reads its own GitHub activity at request time instead of listing projects by hand, so it cannot quietly go stale.

projects.title: EcoHive
projects.body: Log a verifiable green action, earn a credit, trade it. Built by five people under hackathon time pressure, which is where the actual lesson was.
